snippet.title: After Zero: The Last Drive - World Premiere Reveal | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

The world has ended, and the road is all you have left. After Zero: The Last Drive is a free-roaming roguelike survival adventure set in a post-apocalyptic world with a cyberpunk edge. You're the driver, and time is running out: scout the land and find the four Red Horizon repair parts before the next Cold Wave hits the region. Upgrade your trusty, multi-purpose jalopy with tools like a grappling hook, and push further into the wasteland on every run. Will you make it before the cold sets in?
